640-1339-1832-5231.easyPrerequisites: Your life total is at least 2.
640-1339-1832-5231.description:
Activate Unfulfilled Desires by paying {1} and 1 life, causing you to loot.
The Locust God triggers, creating a 1/1 Insect creature token with flying and haste.
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing the Insect, adding {R}
When the Insect dies, Dross Harvester triggers, causing you to gain 2 life.
Repeat.

1479-2841-7201-8099.easyPrerequisites:
It is not your turn.
There is a land card in your library that can be fetched using Prismatic Vista.
Your life total is 2 or higher.
1479-2841-7201-8099.description:
Fetch a land using Prismatic Vista.
When the fetched land enters, Sapling Nursery and Kodama trigger.
Resolve the Kodama trigger, putting Ghost Town from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Ghost Town enters, Kodama and Sapling Nursery trigger.
Holding priority, activate Ghost Town's first abiltiy by tapping it, adding {C}.
Activate Ghost Town's second ability by paying {0}, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Sapling Nursery from step 4, creating a token.
When the token enters, Kodama triggers, putting Ghost Town from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Ghost Town enters, Sapling Nursery triggers.
Repeat from step 5.

3899-6054-6888.description:
Cast Traveling Plague by paying {3}{B}{B}, attaching it to another creature you control.
When Traveling Plague enters, Gremlin Tamer triggers, creating a creature token.
Activate Spawning Pit by sacrificing the creature Traveling Plague is attached to.
When the creature dies, Traveling Plague triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to the token created in step 2.
When Traveling Plague enters, Gremlin Tamer triggers, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Spawning Pit ability.
Repeat from step 3.

4222-5268-7937.description:
Activate Badgey by tapping it, adding {U}.
Badgey triggers, causing each opponent to lose 1 life and you to gain 1 life
Activate Freed from the Real by paying {U}, untapping Badgey.
Repeat.

301-6602-7859.description:
Activate Goblin Chirurgeon by sacrificing Putrid Goblin.
When Putrid Goblin dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a -1/-1 counter on it due to Tromell.
Resolve the Goblin Chirurgeon ability.
Repeat.

1397-3368.notablePrerequisites: An opponent has six or more cards in their hand.
1397-3368.description:
Cast Rousing Refrain by paying its mana cost
Holding priority, cast Reiterate with buyback by paying {4}{R}{R}, creating a copy of Rousing Refrain and returning Reiterate to your hand.
Resolve the copy of Rousing Refrain, adding at least six {R}.
Repeat from step 2.
1397-3368.notes: You can start the combo instead by casting Rousing Refrain from exile after its last time counter is removed.

1368-1563-4478-6321.notablePrerequisites: You have at least three other cards in your graveyard.
1368-1563-4478-6321.description:
Cast Malevolent Rumble for its escape cost by paying {1}{G} and exiling three other cards from your graveyard, causing you to mill at least three cards and create a 0/1 Eldrazi Spawn creature token.
Activate the Eldrazi Spawn by tapping it, adding {G}.
Activate the Eldrazi Spawn by sacrificing it, adding {C}.
Repeat.

uses.n: Yarus, Roar of the Old Gods

3490-3755-5434-7075.notablePrerequisites: You control a creature that has not been tapped this turn.
3490-3755-5434-7075.description:
Activate a creature by tapping it, adding {1}.
The creature's ability granted to it by Tale of Katara and Toph triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on the creature.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to a creature you control

903-2199-3629.easyPrerequisites: Cloudsteel Kirin attached to a creature you control.
903-2199-3629.notablePrerequisites: Karplusan Minotaur has indestructible, protection from red or protection from creatures.
903-2199-3629.description:
Activate Frenetic Efreet an arbitrarily large number of times by paying {0}.
Resolve a Frenetic Efreet ability, causing you to flip a coin.
Karplusan Minotaur triggers. If you won the flip, it deals 1 damage to any target you choose. If you lost the flip, it deals 1 damage to a target of an opponent's choosing. You cannot lose the game due to this damage due to Cloudsteel Kirin, and Karplusan Minotaur cannot be destroyed due to its indestructibility or protection.
Repeat from step 2.

240-2438-4068-5470.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one Mountain.
240-2438-4068-5470.description:
Activate Atla by paying {2} and tapping it, creating an 0/1 Egg creature token with defender.
Activate a nontoken creature you control using the ability granted to it by Ghired by tapping it, creating a copy of the Egg token.
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing an Egg token.
When the Egg dies, Atla triggers, causing you to reveal cards from the top of your library until you reveal a creature card and put it onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on Carrion Feeder
Repeat from step 2.

uses.n: The Legend of Kuruk // Avatar Kuruk

uses.battlefieldCardState: as a copy of Avatar Kuruk

2719-7009-7309.manaNeeded: {20} minus {1} for each creature and artifact you control each turn
2719-7009-7309.description:
Activate Sakashima of a Thousand Faces using Avatar Kuruk's ability by paying {20} minus {1} for each creature and/or artifact you can tap while activating it, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
At the beginning of your end step, Don & Leo triggers, blinking Sakashima of a Thousand Faces. Choose to have it enter the battlefield as a copy of Avatar Kuruk.
Repeat each turn.

1169-4053-5499--6.notablePrerequisites: The creature with undying does not have a +1/+1 counter on it.
1169-4053-5499--6.description:
Activate the creature with undying by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {3}.
When the creature dies, Solemnity triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a +1/+1 counter on it.
Activate Lotus Ring's equip ability by paying {3}, attaching it to the undying creature.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to a creature you control

4871-5220-5243-5256.notablePrerequisites: You control a nontoken creature that can be cast using one colored mana.
4871-5220-5243-5256.description:
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing the nontoken creature.
When the creature dies, Mortuary and Pitiless Plunderer trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting the creature from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Pitiless Plunderer trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding one mana of any color.
Cast the creature from the top of your library by paying its mana cost
Repeat.

4017-4365-4659-5086-5183.easyPrerequisites: Triskelavus has two or more +1/+1 counters on it.
4017-4365-4659-5086-5183.description:
Activate Triskelavus by paying {1} and removing a +1/+1 counter from it, creating two creature tokens.
Activate a Triskelavite token by sacrificing it, dealing 1 damage to any target and causing you to gain life.
Triskelavus triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing another creature token, adding {C}{C}
Repeat from step 1.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

1010-2292-6972.description:
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing Arcbound Prototype.
When Arcbound Prototype dies, its modular ability and persist ability trigger.
Resolve the modular trigger, putting Arcbound Prototype's +1/+1 counters on another artifact creature.
Resolve the persist trigger, returning Arcbound Prototype from your graveyard to the battlefield. It will not have a -1/-1 counter on it due to its modular ability.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability.
Repeat.

4934-5078-5705.description:
Cast Sensei's Divining Top by paying {1}.
Glaring Fleshraker's first ability triggers, creating a 0/1 Eldrazi Spawn creature token.
When the Eldrazi Spawn enters, Glaring Fleshraker's second ability triggers, dealing 1 damage to each opponent.
When Sensei's Divining Top enters, Amareth triggers.
Holding priority, activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top from the battlefield onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Amareth trigger, causing you to look at the top card of your library, which will be Sensei's Divining Top, and put it into your hand.
Activate the Eldrazi Spawn by sacrificing it, adding {C}.
Repeat.

575-3967-7084.notablePrerequisites: You control two other nontoken creatures that have base power 1 or greater.
575-3967-7084.description:
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing the first additional creature.
When the creature dies, Yedora and Beifong's Bounty Hunters trigger.
Resolve the Beifong's Bounty Hunters trigger, earthbending a land.
Resolve the Yedora trigger, returning the first creature from your graveyard to the battlefield face-down as a Forest.
Resolve the Yahenni ability.
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing the second creature.
When the second creature dies, Yedora and Beifong's Bounty Hunters trigger.
Resolve the Yedora trigger, returning the second creature from your graveyard to the battlefield face-down as a Forest.
Resolve the Beifong's Bounty Hunters trigger, earthbending the first creature.
Resolve the Yahenni ability.
Activate the first and second creature by tapping them, adding {G}{G}.
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing the first creature.
When the creature dies, Yedora and Beifong's Bounty Hunters trigger.
Resolve the Beifong's Bounty Hunters trigger, returning the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Yedora trigger, doing nothing.
Resolve the Yahenni ability.
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing the first creature.
When the creature dies, Yedora and Beifong's Bounty Hunters trigger.
Resolve the Yedora trigger, returning the first creature from your graveyard to the battlefield face-down as a Forest land.
Resolve the Beifong's Bounty Hunters trigger, earthbending the second creature.
Resolve the Yahenni ability.
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing the second creature.
When the creature dies, Yedora and Beifong's Bounty Hunters trigger.
Resolve the Beifong's Bounty Hunters trigger, returning the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Yedora trigger, doing nothing.
Resolve the Yahenni ability.
Repeat from step 6.

719-1669-2366-6879.easyPrerequisites: You are able to play a land this turn.
719-1669-2366-6879.description:
Play Dryad Arbor.
When Dryad Arbor enters as an Ally due to Xenograft, Haru triggers, earthbending Dryad Arbor.
Activate Dryad Arbor by tapping it, adding {G}.
Activate Thaumatog by sacrificing Dryad Arbor.
When Dryad Abor dies, Haru triggers, returning Dryad Arbor from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Dryad Arbor enters as an Ally due to Xenograft, Haru triggers, earthbending Dryad Arbor.
Resolve the Thaumatog ability.
Repeat from step 3.

147-673.easyPrerequisites: There are legal target(s) for Planar Incision.
147-673.description:
Cast Planar Incision by paying its mana cost.
Holding priority, cast Dualcaster Mage by paying its mana cost.
When Dualcaster Mage enters, it triggers, copying Planar Incision, with the copy targeting Dualcaster Mage.
Resolve the copy of Planar Incision, blinking Dualcaster Mage.
Repeat from step 3.

997-3991-6132.description:
Cast Faceless Butcher by paying its mana cost.
When Faceless Butcher enters, its first ability triggers, exiling Metamorphosis Fanatic.
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing Faceless Butcher.
When Faceless Butcher dies, its second ability triggers, returning Metamorphosis Fanatic from exile to the battlefield.
When Metamorphosis Fanatic enters, it triggers, returning Faceless Butcher from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Faceless Butcher enters, its first ability triggers, exiling Metamorphosis Fanatic.
Resolve the Woe Strider ability.
Repeat from step 3.

1850-1863-5413.description:
Activate Trenching Steed by sacrificing a land.
Play the land from your graveyard.
Repeat.
1850-1863-5413.notes: If the land can tap for mana once it enters the battlefield, you can do so for infinite mana.

2034-3562-4679-6023.description:
Activate Yenna by paying {2} and tapping it, creating a token copy of Sky Hussar.
When the Sky Hussar token enters, it triggers, untapping all creatures you control.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Sky Hussar token, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat.

2350-2661-3692.description:
Activate Gwenna by tapping it, adding {U}{U} that can only be spent to cast creature spells or activate abilities of creatures.
Cast Aethersnipe for its evoke cost by paying {U}{U}.
Gwenna triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it and untapping it.
When Aethersnipe enters the battlefield, its first ability and evoke ability trigger.
Resolve the first Aethersnipe trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the second Aethersnipe trigger, failing to sacrifice it as it is no longer on the battlefield.
Repeat.

527-800-4116.description:
Activate Volrath by paying {1}, causing it to become a copy of Selvala.
Activate Volrath by paying {G} and tapping it, adding at least {5}{G}{U}.
Activate Volrath by paying {1}, causing it to become a copy of Knacksaw Clique.
Activate Volrath by paying {1}{U} and untapping it, exiling the top card of an opponent's library with the ability to play it until end of turn.
Repeat.

413-560-2835-4550.notablePrerequisites: You have at least two cards in hand.
413-560-2835-4550.description:
Activate Zombie Infestation by discarding two cards, creating a 2/2 Zombie creature token and a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
When the Zombie and Soldier enter the battlefield, Blasting Station triggers twice.
Resolve the first Blasting Station trigger, untapping it.
Holding priority, activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing the Zombie.
When the Zombie dies, Fecundity triggers, causing you to draw a card.
Resolve the Blasting Station ability, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Repeat from step 3 for the remaining Blasting Station trigger, sacrificing the Soldier token instead.
Repeat.

1140-1636-3143-6177.easyPrerequisites:
You control at least one Forest Dryad token.
Xavier Sal does not have summoning sickness.
There is a counter on a permanent you control.
1140-1636-3143-6177.description:
Activate Xavier Sal by tapping it and removing a counter from a permanent you control, creating a token copy of the Forest Dryad token.
When the Forest Dryad enters the battlefield, Intruder Alarm and Vinelasher Kudzu trigger.
Resolve the Vinelasher Kudzu trigger, putting a counter on a creature you control.
Resolve the Intruder Alarm trigger, untapping all creatures.
Repeat.

190-389-5248-6035.notablePrerequisites: Your life total is 5 or less.
190-389-5248-6035.description:
Cast Courageous Resolve by paying {2}{W}.
Cast Fractured Identity by paying {3}{W}{U}, exiling Nine Lives and causing each opponent to create a token copy of it.
Nine Lives leaves the battlefield, however you cannot lose the game due to Courageous Resolve.
Cast Cleansing Nova by paying its mana cost, destroying all enchantments.
When each opponent's Nine Lives leaves the battlefield, they each trigger, causing each opponent to lose the game.

2034-2232-4766-5987.easyPrerequisites: Deathrender attached to a creature you control.
2034-2232-4766-5987.notablePrerequisites: If the creature with Deathrender attached is an artifact creature and/or has mana value 5 or greater, you have a nonartifact creature card with mana value 4 or less in your graveyard.
2034-2232-4766-5987.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the creature with Deathrender attached, adding {C}{C}.
When the creature dies, Deathrender triggers, putting Angel of Indemnity from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Angel of Indemnity enters the battlefield, it and Cloudstone Curio trigger.
Resolve the Cloudstone Curio trigger, choosing to return nothing to your hand from the battlefield.
Resolve the Angel of Indemnity trigger, returning any nonartifact creature card from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When the creature enters the battlefield, Cloudstone Curio triggers, returning Angel of Indemnity from the battlefield to your hand.
Activate Deathrender's equip ability by paying {2}, attaching it to the creature.
Repeat.

1447-2438-2719.description:
Cast Angel of Glory's Rise by paying {5}{W}{W}.
When Angel of Glory's Rise enters the battlefield, it triggers.
Holding priority, activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing Sakashima of a Thousand Faces, putting a +1/+1 counter on Carrion Feeder.
Resolve the Angel of Glory's Rise trigger, exiling all Zombies, and then returning all Humans from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Choose to have Sakashima of a Thousand Faces enter the battlefield as a copy of Angel of Glory's Rise.
When Sakashima of a Thousand Faces enters the battlefield, it triggers.
Repeat from step 3.

3480-4499-4747.description:
Activate Emiel the Blessed by paying {3}, blinking Alena.
Activate Alena by tapping it, adding at least {R}{R}{R}{R}.
Repeat.
Once you have infinite mana, you may blink any other creature(s) you control.

2034-3994-4013.description:
Activate Eldrazi Displacer by paying {2}{C}, blinking Precursor Golem.
When Precursor Golem enters, it triggers, creating two creature tokens.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing two creature tokens, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}.
Repeat.

1912-1978-3371.notablePrerequisites: Codie does not have summoning sickness.
1912-1978-3371.description:
Activate Codie by paying {2} and tapping it, adding {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}.
Activate Voltaic Construct by paying {1}, untapping Codie.
Repeat.
Once you have an arbitrarily large number of Codie triggers, you may cast any instant or sorcery spell by paying its mana cost.
Codie triggers for each time you activated its ability.
Resolve the first trigger, causing you to exile cards from the top of your library until you exile an instant or sorcery spell with lesser mana value, and allowing you to cast that spell without paying its mana cost.
Repeat step 6 for each remaining trigger.
You may also repeat this combo for each instant and/or sorcery card in your hand, and on subsequent turns.

4980-5037-5147-5220.notablePrerequisites: Anje does not have summoning sickness.
4980-5037-5147-5220.description:
Activate Anje by tapping it and discarding Blazing Rootwalla.
Blazing Rootwalla is discarded into exile due to its madness ability.
Anje and Blazing Rootwalla trigger.
Resolve the Anje trigger, untapping it.
Resolve the Blazing Rootwalla trigger, causing you to pay {0} to cast it from exile.
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing Blazing Rootwalla.
When Blazing Rootwalla dies, Mortuary triggers, putting Blazing Rootwalla on top of your library from your graveyard.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Resolve the Anje ability from step 1, causing you to draw Blazing Rootwalla from the top of your library.
Repeat.

992-2702.description:
All creatures your opponent control lose flying.
Moat prevents things without flying from attacking.
Creatures your opponent can not fulfill the conditions necessary to attack.
